questions.question: Operation Dronagiri aims to demonstrate the applications of geospatial technologies in enhancing citizens' quality of life and ease of doing business. It was launched by the _____.
options: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Ministry of Science and Technology (MoST)) है।

questions.question: Horse burials have been reported from ___________ near Nagpur in Maharashtra in the Iron Age.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Junapani) है।

questions.question: Parishishtaparvan was written by ________________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Hemachandra) है।

questions.question: In which of the following years was the Dowry Prohibition Act brought into effect?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (1961) है।

questions.question: Who among the following was elected as the Deputy President of the FIDE in August 2022?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Viswanathan Anand) है।

questions.question: The Sandalwood film industry is associated with which language?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Kannada) है।

questions.question: Match the Finance Commissions in List-I with their respective Chairmen in List-II.List-I (Finance Commissions)                       List-II (Chairmen)A) Eighth Finance Commission                    I) AK ChandaB) Sixth Finance Commission                      II) K Brahmananda Reddy C) Eleventh Finance Commission                III) AM KhusroD) Third Finance Commission                     IV) YB Chavan
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (A-IV, B-II, C-III, D-I) है।

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of rivers in India and their sources is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Ganga – Gangotri Glacier) है।

questions.question: According to the Forest Survey Report, 2021, which of the following forest areas has seen an increase of 17 square kilometres compared to the previous assessment?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Mangrove) है।

questions.question: The Preamble of India declares that India is a republic which means that the:
options: Head of the State is the Chief Justice of India
Head of the State is the President
Head of the State is the Prime Minister
Head of the State is the Home Minister
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Head of the State is the President) है।

questions.question: Which of the following organisations are involved in the bi-lateral cooperation programme, 'Rural Financial Institutions Programme' (RFIP), to facilitate effective financial inclusion of low-income households in India?
options: RBI and United Nations Development Programme
NABARD and German Society for International Cooperation
NABARD and Cooperative for Assistance and Relief Everywhere
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (NABARD and German Society for International Cooperation) है।

questions.question: Phenolphthalein, a commonly used acid-base indicator, changes from colorless to pink at which pH range?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (8.2 – 10.0) है।

questions.question: Where was the opening ceremony of the 38th National Games 2025 held?
options: Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium, Dehradun
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium, Dehradun) है।

questions.question: In July 2025, ISRO announced the successful development of which system for the Gaganyaan human spaceflight mission?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Service Module Propulsion System) है।

questions.question: Who among the following was the first full-time woman External Affairs Minister of India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Sushma Swaraj) है।

questions.question: Which statement best reflects the view of extremist leaders towards British rule and justice in India during colonial times?
options: British rule was selfish and exploitative
British rule was fair and just
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (British rule was selfish and exploitative) है।

questions.question: What was the primary focus of the UN80 Initiative announced by the UN Secretary-General in 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Transform how the UN works) है।

questions.question: Which Himalayan range consists of the loftiest peaks and is perennially snow-bound with many glaciers descending from it?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Himadri) है।

questions.question: When was the Economic Survey 2024-25 tabled in the Indian Parliament?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (January 31, 2025) है।

questions.question: Which of the following committees' recommendations led to the establishment of the Central Vigilance Commission in 1964?
options: Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption
Mehta Committee on Prevention of Corruption
Tendulkar Committee on Prevention of Corruption
Sharma Committee on Prevention of Corruption
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption) है।
